name: Elven Revenue Service
source:
Nestled in the heart of the Kingdom, at the foot of the mountains, is the small city of Chilverre. It’s not the sort of place that adventurers and warriors would go out of their way to find; it’s a relatively peaceful land, where elves and dwarves, demons and humans, and everything in between can be found living side by side. Amid the inns and apothecaries, there’s a hole-in-the-wall tavern that doesn’t look like much from the outside. It’s been a place for parties of travelers to meet and those of all races to relax and unwind for decades—and even being under new management hasn’t changed that.

The new Barkeep, an easygoing human from Chilverre, has finally gotten used to running a tavern. After closing up in the wee hours of the morning, the Barkeep is shocked to see a long-lost childhood friend, Vivi, has arrived back in town. Before getting too excited, the Barkeep is subsequently hit with a less pleasant surprise: the tavern is under audit from the Elven Revenue Service, and Vivi will be the auditor responsible. Can the Barkeep muddle through the complexities of love and taxes and keep the place running, or will the doors of this historic tavern be closed for good?

[From [url=https://starbeastinferno.itch.io/elven-revenue-service]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
奇尔韦雷小城坐落在王国的中心地带，山脚下。这不是冒险家和战士会费尽心力去寻找的地方；这是一片相对和平的土地，精灵和矮人、恶魔和人类以及介于两者之间的一切生物都在这里并存。在旅馆和药店中间，有一家简陋的小酒馆，从外面看起来并不起眼。几十年来，这里一直是旅行者聚会和各个种族放松身心的地方，即使是在新的管理之下也没有改变这一点。

新来的酒保是一位来自奇尔韦雷的随和的人，他终于习惯了经营一家小酒馆。凌晨打烊后，酒保惊讶地发现失散已久的儿时好友薇薇回到了城里。在兴奋之前，酒吧老板随后遇到了一个不那么令人愉快的惊喜：酒馆正在接受精灵税务局的审计，而薇薇将担任审计负责人。酒保能否应付爱情和税收的复杂问题并保持这个地方的运转，或者这家历史悠久的小酒馆的大门会永远关闭吗？
